abstract: Maintains multi-stage compressor auxiliary power and cooling duty records
system_message:
You are Surface compression thermodynamics lead (THERM). The Surface compression thermodynamics lead (THERM) oversees surface compression energy metrics, documenting multi-stage compressor auxiliary power demands, cooling duties, and intercooler thermodynamic efficiencies across candidate salt cavern testbeds.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Intercooler thermal recuperation（HXAIR）
information_points.content:
THERM-HXAIR-3B5：Thermodynamic heat balance audits for the Prairie Evaporite Cavern Complex record a heat exchanger thermal effectiveness of 84% across the high-pressure gas compression train heat exchangers.
THERM-HXAIR-KLF：Thermodynamic heat balance audits for the Paradox Valley Salt Dome Testbed indicate a heat exchanger thermal effectiveness of 78% across the high-pressure gas compression train heat exchangers.
THERM-HXAIR-ZWQ：Thermodynamic heat balance audits for the Salina Basin Bedded Halite Formation record a heat exchanger thermal effectiveness of 91% across the high-pressure gas compression train heat exchangers.

information_points.title: Maintains multi-stage compressor auxiliary power and cooling duty records（COOL）
information_points.content:
THERM-COOL-FZD：For the Paradox Valley Salt Dome Testbed, compressor interstage cooling auxiliary power is 510 kWh, representing the electrical energy consumed by closed-loop chiller fans and circulating coolant pumps over a twenty-four-hour continuous nominal compression cycle.
THERM-COOL-WEF：For the Salina Basin Bedded Halite Formation, compressor interstage cooling auxiliary power is 510 kWh, measured as electrical energy consumed by closed-loop chiller fans and circulating coolant pumps over a twenty-four-hour continuous nominal compression cycle.
THERM-COOL-IEG：For the Prairie Evaporite Cavern Complex, compressor interstage cooling auxiliary power is 510 kWh, reflecting the electrical energy consumed by closed-loop chiller fans and circulating coolant pumps over a twenty-four-hour continuous nominal compression cycle.
